mapper.select: select cc.class_id, cc.term_id, cc.teacher_id, cc.capacity, cc.selected_count, cc.status, cc.class_time, cc.location, c.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credit_hours from course_class cc left join course c on cc.course_id = c.course_id where cc.class_id = #{classId} limit 1
mapper.update: update course_class set selected_count = selected_count + 1 where class_id = #{classId} and selected_count < capacity
mapper.select: select cc.class_id, cc.class_time from course_class cc inner join enrollment e on e.class_id = cc.class_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status = 'ENROLLED' and cc.term_id = #{termId}

select cc.class_id, cc.class_time, cc.location, c.course_name, u.nick_name as teacher_name from course_class cc inner join enrollment e on e.class_id = cc.class_id left join course c on c.course_id = cc.course_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = cc.teacher_id where e.student_id = #{studentId} and e.status = 'ENROLLED' and cc.term_id = #{termId}
